reviews.scope: Attack the actual first-playable prototype's pause/restart/event boundaries and inspect export configuration. No full MVP, physical-controller, public-package, or canonical milestone acceptance.

findings.title: Immediate pause discards the authoritative queued launch event
findings.expected_behavior: A launch accepted before pause remains queued and reaches the run lifecycle once after resume.
findings.reproduction: Start Survival; send launch; pause before the next physics callback; wait three physics frames; resume; wait five frames. Originally session remains ready/elapsed 0 while truck launch_ready is false.
findings.follow_up_scope: Retain queued authoritative events while simulation is disabled and preserve unprocessed events if publication pauses inside a callback.
findings.fix_claim_evidence: Owner changes are described in docs/red_team/reviews/RT-0002-prototype-boundaries.md and identified by original/fixing source manifests.

findings.title: Controller disconnect resumes an already paused run
findings.expected_behavior: Controller loss pauses gameplay idempotently and leaves an already paused game paused.
findings.reproduction: Launch; pause; call input_adapter._connection_changed(0, false). Originally paused becomes false, screen gameplay, session running.
findings.follow_up_scope: Use a distinct idempotent disconnect pause request instead of the player pause toggle.
findings.fix_claim_evidence: Owner changes are described in docs/red_team/reviews/RT-0002-prototype-boundaries.md and identified by original/fixing source manifests.

findings.title: Coordinator overwrites stale run identity and awards an old event
findings.expected_behavior: An event from a previous run cannot enter the current run stream or award it points.
findings.reproduction: Create a valid building event for yard_run_4; restart and launch yard_run_5; deliver the old event to bootstrap._event. Originally it grants 100 points and one destroyed building.
findings.follow_up_scope: Validate the original producer envelope and reject mismatched run identity before constructing a globally ordered event.
findings.fix_claim_evidence: Owner changes are described in docs/red_team/reviews/RT-0002-prototype-boundaries.md and identified by original/fixing source manifests.

findings.title: Same-frame restarts remove an already detached overlay
findings.expected_behavior: Rapid restarts remove transient UI once without engine ownership errors.
findings.reproduction: Start/restart before the next frame frees a removed overlay. Original attack log shows two p_child->data.parent != this errors from show_gameplay/remove_child.
findings.follow_up_scope: Clear the overlay reference when detaching/queuing it so repeated starts cannot remove it twice.
findings.fix_claim_evidence: Owner changes are described in docs/red_team/reviews/RT-0002-prototype-boundaries.md and identified by original/fixing source manifests.

backlog_crawl_policy.selection: Completed, eligible, unreviewed tasks with explicit acceptance proof; prioritize high-risk and highly depended-on work.
backlog_crawl_policy.ordering: Topological, then acceptance time, then numerical task ID for ties.
backlog_crawl_policy.skip: Trivial tasks unless explicitly requested; record the reason. Missing completion evidence does not imply acceptance.
backlog_crawl_policy.resolution_rule: Never mark a finding resolved without a separate passing re-verification event testing the original reproduction against the fixing revision.
